rows.supplier_clause: Let $P\ge1$ named phase branches of the same finite species list occupy a separated compound at an attained global entropy-maximizing endpoint with the fixed totals and exact feasible set declared by *Phase branches and coexistence domains* and *Isolated compound and feasible equilibrium set*. Assume each phase lies in an open C2 single-phase chart with finite positive temperature. For every pair of phases and each exchange channel used in the conclusion, assume the following about the exact feasible set at this endpoint. For every $\epsilon>0$ there is a feasible pure transfer with increment $a$ satisfying $0<a<\epsilon$, and there is one with increment $b$ satisfying $-\epsilon<b<0$, in the channel's fixed SI numerical coordinate. Each transfer adds its dimensioned increment to the selected coordinate of one phase and subtracts it from the same coordinate of the other phase, while every nonselected coordinate of both phases, every other phase, and every auxiliary state is fixed at its endpoint value. This requires feasible increments approaching zero from each sign; it does not require a full interval of feasible transfers.
rows.consumer_clause: Suppose a state $(T_0,p_0)\in O$ is an attained interior coexistence equilibrium with bilateral energy, volume, and species exchange between the two branches, and both branches admit the valid local Gibbs charts of *Local thermodynamic Legendre potentials*. Precisely, in each of these three exchange directions, feasible nonzero pure pairwise increments approach zero from each sign, while every nonselected coordinate of both phases, every other phase, and every auxiliary state is fixed at its endpoint value.
rows.consumer_fact: [F3] [[pthm-td-intensive-coexistence-conditions]]: at an attained entropy maximum, pure pairwise energy, volume, and species transfers with feasible nonzero increments approaching zero from each sign, and every nonselected phase and auxiliary coordinate fixed, give equal positive temperatures, equal pressures, and equal chemical potentials. The Statement supplies exactly these transfer hypotheses.
rows.disposition: current applied source supplies exact supplier premise
rows.review: The applied Statement now explicitly supplies arbitrarily small pure increments from each sign with all other phase and auxiliary coordinates fixed. Its C2 entropy/positive-temperature/attained maximum hypotheses remain. Current F3 supports equality of mu at proof 1.1 and hence the equal-Gibbs basepoint under same-tag homogeneity. rows.consumer_clause: The branch theorems on this page require the stated smooth local charts. Here coexistence means an attained global entropy-maximizing endpoint on the exact feasible set of *Phase branches and coexistence domains*; equality of intensive phase data follows only for the bilateral exchanges assumed in the branch theorems and does not itself imply loss of chart regularity. The smooth-branch conclusions apply only on their specified C1 charts and interior composition domains. They supply no conclusion where a branch chart fails to be C1, a species amount reaches the composition boundary, or the specified coexistence-and-affinity Jacobian lacks its required nonsingular minor. In particular, *Local Clapeyron slope on a regular pure-phase coexistence branch* requires a nonzero molar-volume jump; when that jump vanishes, its local graph argument and quotient formula do not apply.
